name: HYDRA DNA Collagen Sparkling Beverage (Berry Punch)
ingredients_text: Carbonated Water, Collagen Peptides, Tapioca Soluble Fiber, Natural Flavors, Citric Acid, Malic Acid, Sea Trace Minerals, Potassium Chloride, Mushroom Extract, Stevia, Ascorbic Acid (Vit C), Vegetable Juice (For Color), Himalayan Pink Salt, Fulvic Acid.
description: Sparkling liquid collagen protein water drink. Balanced nutrients for wellness. Sugar-free, keto-friendly. 12g collagen peptides + Himalayan pink salt + 72 trace minerals + fulvic acid. No artificial sweeteners or colors. Gluten-free.

Protein.form: collagen (incomplete protein - no tryptophan, low BCAA)

Sodium.form: Himalayan pink salt + sea trace minerals

Trace minerals (72 marine + fulvic acid).note: Marine source not Wallach's preferred humic-shale PDM lineage. Fulvic acid inclusion is closer to PDM framework than typical seawater-trace beverages but does NOT replace Majestic Earth PDM Liquid.

Mushroom extract (unspecified).note: Species not disclosed. All medicinal mushrooms are framework-adjacent — not in Wallach corpus.

Prebiotic fiber (tapioca soluble).note: Framework-adjacent. Wallach corpus does not specifically address prebiotic fibers.
